_comment: Exact list of Microsoft fonts the UI expects and the open replacement for each. 'ms_files' are the genuine files exported from the XP VM into references/xp_export/fonts (never committed). 'kind': metric = same advance widths (layout identical), approx = similar look, different widths, builtin = shipped in wine/fonts (original or LGPL Wine work), none = no open equivalent. The open table behind the 'metric' entries is fontconfig's 30-metric-aliases.conf (Liberation/Croscore, Carlito, Caladea).

fonts.notes: same metrics as Arial; Arimo is the identical Croscore design
Wine's own Tahoma look-alike; the shell and dialogs use it (MS Shell Dlg 2 -> Tahoma)
Wine ships a bitmap-style 'MS Sans Serif' (wine/fonts/ms_sans_serif.sfd) for the old bitmap name
wide humanist sans like Verdana; widths differ by a few percent
Luna caption font (10pt bold). No metric-compatible open font exists; Fira Sans or Open Sans (OFL) look closer if installed
Longhorn-era UI font; not in Debian, install manually when needed
